proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: CxEngage tenant/data residency may not meet non-NA/EU policy.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All mandatory data classes and support paths meet policy contractually.

proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Required outbound modes may cross product/add-on boundaries.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Required modes operate under one understood support/economic model and compliance controls pass.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Create two client programs with shared agents where required and prove isolation, reporting, WEM/QM, integrations, AI and usage.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Access tests, reports, recordings, usage data, incident logs.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Cross-client visibility/policy leakage, shared blast radius or unusable chargeback.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Why is this buyer on CxEngage versus CCSP/White Label, and what hard controls differ?

proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: CCSP hard tenancy does not automatically prove CxEngage BPO isolation.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No cross-client leakage; operating model and chargeback are viable.

proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Silent/duplicate/unauthorized action, unrecoverable partial state or missing audit.

proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Sandbox system of record, test identities, realistic connector permissions.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Autonomous actions are not safe until failure/recovery semantics are proven.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Unauthorized/duplicate actions blocked or reconciled; partial failure visible; compensation/recovery and audit complete.

proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Safe bridge can become permanent dual-platform debt.

proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every mandatory claim is contractually bound to exact service; dependencies are identified.
